'''Armed conflicts and attacks''' 
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]], [[Gaza Strip famine]], [[Gaza genocide]]
***[[Israel]] announces the suspension of many international [[humanitarian aid|humanitarian]] organizations, including [[Doctors Without Borders]], the [[International Rescue Committee]], and divisions of [[Oxfam]] and [[Caritas Internationalis|Caritas]], from operating in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] starting January 1 for allegedly failing to pass new rules to vet the organizations and cooperating with [[Hamas]] and other [[Palestinian Joint Operations Room|militant groups]]. [https://apnews.com/article/gaza-israel-hamas-palestinians-ceasefire-war-news-286106d7a5a911704cdcf1c93248e502 (AP)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**[[2025 Southern Yemen offensive]], [[Saudi-led intervention in the Yemeni civil war]], [[Saudi Arabia–United Arab Emirates relations]]
***The [[Royal Saudi Air Force]] strikes the port of [[Mukalla]], [[Yemen]], targeting a ship with weapons delivered from the [[United Arab Emirates]] (UAE) to the [[Southern Transitional Council]]. [https://apnews.com/article/saudi-arabia-bomb-yemen-mukalla-weapons-uae-9fc56e4678a12f56d61b1ecf855d4a4e (AP)]
**Yemen ends its [[defense pact]] with the UAE, with [[Presidential Leadership Council|its leader]] [[Rashad al-Alimi]] ordering all [[United Arab Emirates Armed Forces|Emirati forces]] to depart within 24 hours. He also declares a 90-day national [[state of emergency]] and a three-day [[blockade]] of the country's southern and eastern [[Governorates of Yemen|regions]]. The UAE later announces that its remaining forces in Yemen will leave the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/saudi-led-coalition-yemen-calls-civilians-mukalla-port-evacuate-saudi-state-news-2025-12-30/ (Reuters)] [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2025/12/273362/yemen-orders-uae-forces-to-leave-amid-rising-tensions-with-saudi-arabia/ (Morocco World News)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***29 [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] militants are killed by the [[Somali Armed Forces]] in Jabad Godane, [[Middle Shabelle]], Somalia. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/somalia-says-it-killed-29-al-shabaab-militants-with-international-support-2026-01-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Hungary]]
**[[Moody's Ratings|Moody's]] downgrades the [[credit rating]] of the city of [[Budapest]], Hungary, to Ba1 and places it on review for a further cut, citing weak [[Funding liquidity|liquidity]], uncertainty over state transfers, rising [[Tax rates in Europe|solidarity tax]] obligations, and [[Rule of Law Conditionality Regulation|the partial suspension]] of [[European Union]] funds to Hungary. [https://www.reuters.com/world/moodys-cuts-budapests-rating-junk-due-row-with-national-government-2025-12-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Ollantaytambo District train collision]]
**Two trains on a [[Rail transport in Peru|rail line]] between [[Cusco]] to [[Machu Picchu]] in [[Urubamba province]], [[Peru]], [[head-on collision|collide]],  killing a train driver and injuring 40 passengers. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/31/train-crash-near-perus-machu-picchu-kills-driver-injures-dozens (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/train-collision-near-machu-picchu-peru/ (CBS News)]
*[[Search for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370]]
**The search for the wreckage of [[Malaysia Airlines Flight 370]] resumes in the southern [[Indian Ocean]] under a [[contingent fee]] agreement between the [[Malaysia]]n [[Government of Malaysia|government]] and [[Ocean Infinity]], which has deployed [[autonomous underwater vehicle]]s. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20251230-mh370-search-resumes-in-indian-ocean-years-after-plane-disappearance (AFP via France 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Burkina Faso–United States relations]], [[Mali–United States relations]]
**[[Burkina Faso]] and [[Mali]] impose [[Reciprocity (international relations)|reciprocal]] [[travel ban]]s on Americans after the [[United States]] added them to a list of countries subject to [[Second Trump travel ban|a full U.S. entry ban]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mali-burkina-faso-announce-reciprocal-travel-ban-us-2025-12-31/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Deportation in the second Trump administration]]
**[[United States federal judge|U.S. federal judge]] [[Angel Kelley]] of [[United States District Court for the District of Massachusetts|Massachusetts]] blocks [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|the Trump administration]]'s plan to end [[temporary protected status]] for [[South Sudan]]ese nationals, issuing an [[administrative stay]] that prevents the expiration of [[Deportation from the United States|deportation]] protections while a legal challenge proceeds. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-judge-halts-end-deportation-protections-south-sudanese-migrants-2025-12-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Turkey–Islamic State conflict]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]] [[General Directorate of Security (Turkey)|police]] detain 357 people nationwide suspected of being [[Islamic State]] members following clashes between the two sides yesterday. [https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-detains-357-suspects-after-islamic-state-clashes/a-75343106 (DW)]
*[[Western Syria clashes]]
**[[Syria]]n authorities arrest 21 people in the [[Latakia Governorate]] and impose a curfew in [[Latakia|the provincial capital]] following [[sectarian violence]] linked to [[unrest]] after [[2025 Homs mosque bombing|a mosque bombing]] and protests in [[Alawite]]-majority areas. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/12/30/syria-arrests-21-linked-to-alassad-rule-as-curfew-covers-port-city (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
